name: Elegant Comfort Reversible Quilted Sofa Cover, Chocolate/Cream
description: Elegant Comfort Reversible Quilted Sofa Cover, Chocolate/Cream; Now you can invite your beloved pets back onto the couch when you protect it with the Elegant Comfort Reversible Quilted Sofa Cover. Theres no question you love your pets like family, but you could probably live without the fur, paw prints and dirt they leave behind in your home. This high-quality sofa cover is made from 100% polyester and is quilted for extra comfort. Its also features a soil-resistant, water-repellent finish to help keep stains and spills of all sorts from reaching your couch; the long back panel and attached tie straps help keep it in place on most standard-sized sofas up to 92 inches long. The four available color combinations and innovative dual-sided construction provide a wide range of looks to complement almost any décor.
